digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler bridge gate and pause/resume
propositions: Dual-format pause/resume blob surface must preserve legacy readers by retaining gated_mode and reconcile-check early return while adding paused, reason, who, and paused_at metadata

Pause operation must enforce durable CAS semantics: idempotent on same reason, reject on different reason or blank reason, refuse on missing identity or remote or CAS conflict, and preserve metadata on re-pause

New pause must block before lock acquisition or ticket mutation and return exactly rc 0 with anchored BRIDGE_PAUSED JSON marker; scheduled workflow recognizes only that complete marker and skips commit-and-push
Resume must delete observed ref OID via CAS and safely recover from corrupt blob state without decoding or traceback

Rollback-safe migration must maintain old reconcile vocabulary, pre-gate reconcile-check behavior, legacy gate exit-4 mapping, and existing workflow/environment compatibility without automatic expiry or rename
